overview.description: The GraniteShares YieldBoost AMZN ETF (AZYY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund is actively managed seeking current income and the daily 2x leverage of the price performance of Amazon Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) AZYY was launched on Sep 16, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
